facts.text: UMass Lowell's business school offers co-ops: full-time, paid work experiences, usually six months long, tied to your academic program.

sources.title: Professional Co-ops - Manning School of Business - UMass Lowell

facts.text: UMass Lowell's Immersive Scholars, pre-selected from first-year applicants, receive up to $4,000 for approved experiential learning programs.
